snippet.title: Silent Wounds - Ep1 Trailer | Free to Play Horror
snippet.description:
No monsters. No escape. Just a psychological descent into madness.
Uncover the unsettling mystery of Victor in Silent Wounds.

👇 WISHLIST Silent Wounds on Steam now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4251070/Silent_Wounds__The_Doll/

About The Game:
Silent Wounds is an intense, 1-hour focused psychological horror experience that slowly unravels your sanity. Dive deep into a narrative-driven nightmare where your mind is your greatest enemy.

The first episode arrives on October 15th, 2026 and will be entirely Free to Play
